sourceData.mnemonic: This word consists of kanji with hiragana attached. Because the hiragana ends with an <ja>う</ja> sound, you know this word is a verb. The kanji itself means <kanji>bake</kanji> or <kanji>cook</kanji>. So, the verb vocab version is <vocabulary>to bake</vocabulary> or <vocabulary>to cook</vocabulary>.
sourceData.readingMnemonic: The reading comes from the reading you learned with the kanji.
